data.gender_notes: Tybie is used as a unisex name in Christian naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Derived from the English word 'ty' meaning 'tender' and 'be' meaning 'heart'. This name signifies a gentle and compassionate spirit. The name Tybie carries the meaning “Tender heart” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Greek, Latin. Parents who choose Tybie usually hope their child will grow to embody tender heart and live with faith, good character and purpose.
